source_snapshot.procedure: Send one authenticated HTTPS GET to `/redfish/v1/Managers/{ManagerId}/HostInterfaces/{HostInterfaceId}/HostEthernetInterfaces`, pipe JSON to jq and dump the result.
source_snapshot.criteria: Result should be human readable and command should work without error.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek preserves the correct collection URI and GET method but uses TLS bypass, direct credential expansion and leaves all JSON interpretation to the user.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that one selected Manager HostInterface exposes a readable HostEthernetInterfaces collection and that the returned collection document is structurally valid and human-readable without changing network state.
original_test_intent.target: The Redfish EthernetInterfaceCollection linked by one verified `/Managers/{ManagerId}/HostInterfaces/{HostInterfaceId}` resource, not the Manager EthernetInterfaces collection and not the ComputerSystem EthernetInterfaces collection.
original_test_intent.scope: One OOB GET of the advertised HostEthernetInterfaces collection; validate the collection identity, member count and member links. Dereferencing every EthernetInterface member and validating link speed, addresses or VLAN configuration is outside the literal source scope.
original_test_intent.operation: Discover Manager and HostInterface by following Redfish links, obtain the exact HostEthernetInterfaces `@odata.id`, perform one trusted authenticated GET, validate HTTP/JSON/collection invariants, redact sensitive identifiers in derived summaries and preserve the raw access-controlled artifact. Do not clear logs or write network configuration.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 15 attended and 10 machine minutes and specifies one collection GET.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The advertised collection URI returns a successful HTTP status and parseable EthernetInterfaceCollection JSON whose `Members@odata.count` equals the number of member link objects and whose member `@odata.id` values identify resources belonging to that collection. Platform-required presence/count needs a separate product requirement.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: BMC/firmware/Manager/HostInterface identity; discovered HostEthernetInterfaces link; timestamp/tool/TLS context; HTTP status and headers needed for interpretation; raw protected and redacted rendered collection; `@odata.id`, `@odata.type`, member count and member links; no-mutation audit.
ambiguities: The source only requires human-readable/no-error output and does not define collection structure, mandatory member count or expected members.
The source hardcodes credentials, uses `-k` and clears logs.
HostEthernetInterfaces can be confused with `/Managers/{ManagerId}/EthernetInterfaces` or `/Systems/{SystemId}/EthernetInterfaces`, which represent different scopes.
The collection response does not necessarily inline per-member speed, link, address or VLAN fields.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly keeps the query read-only, discovers the links, secures credentials/TLS and distinguishes the HostInterface collection. It overstates source evidence by requiring member status/link/speed and MAC/IP/VLAN redaction as though member resources were returned or dereferenced; the source specifies only one collection GET.

applicable_history.decision: Historical YES confirms the one-shot OOB GET is executable; it does not authorize expansion into member-resource validation or define a mandatory member count.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep FULLY AUTOMATABLE. V3 preserves one HostEthernetInterfaces collection GET, validates exact collection invariants and execution location, and removes V2's unsupported implication that per-member network telemetry is part of this row.

available_now: The standard collection URI and HostInterface navigation relationship are defined.
The request is read-only and structurally verifiable without a platform threshold.
ManagerId and HostInterfaceId can be discovered from live Redfish links instead of guessed.
missing_inputs: Runtime BMC endpoint, authorized credential handle, trusted CA and target HostInterface are resolved from the lab assignment.
A platform requirement is needed only to judge a required member count or particular member identities.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: Lab inventory and secret management provide normal access; the platform owner provides any mandatory HostInterface/NIC population. Normal runtime resolution does not block the standard query.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Discover Manager/HostInterface links, GET the advertised collection and validate collection/member-link invariants.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not clear logs, use hardcoded credentials or TLS bypass, PATCH/POST network resources, follow actions, confuse BMC/System NIC collections with HostEthernetInterfaces, dereference members as unstated scope, or claim a universal required member count.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Verify the resource chain and trusted session, capture a successful structurally valid collection, reconcile member count and links, record any platform-requirement gap and prove no network state changed.

revision_candidate.purpose: Retrieve and structurally validate the EthernetInterface collection used by the host to communicate with one selected Redfish HostInterface.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: A BMC Redfish service advertising Manager HostInterfaces and a HostEthernetInterfaces link for the selected resource instance.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One advertised HostEthernetInterfaces collection under one Manager HostInterface. Manager management ports, System NIC inventory and individual member payloads are outside scope.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Verified BMC/firmware; discovered ManagerId, HostInterfaceId and HostEthernetInterfaces `@odata.id`; read-only credential handle; trusted CA; curl/JSON validator; protected evidence location; signed required-presence/member-population versus approved unsupported/not-applicable disposition; bounded pagination page/member limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: GET the Manager HostInterfaces collection, select the authorized HostInterface and read its HostEthernetInterfaces `@odata.id`. If the signed platform policy requires or advertises the collection, perform authenticated trusted-TLS GETs of that exact collection and every same-origin `Members@odata.nextLink` until no next link remains, enforcing the signed page/member bounds, rejecting cross-origin or repeated links, and preserving each page. Validate status and JSON per page, collection `@odata.id`/`@odata.type`, aggregate all `Members`, reconcile the aggregate with `Members@odata.count`, and validate each member link without dereferencing member resources. If the signed policy permits an absent or unsupported collection, record unsupported/not applicable without calling it collection PASS. Do not clear logs or write networking.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct BMC/Manager and HostInterface verified through resource links; trusted TLS and protected credentials available; logs preserved; no network mutation requested; collection parser qualified.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Target and firmware identity; signed presence/population disposition; discovered resource chain; timestamp/tool/TLS context; per-page URI and HTTP status; protected raw and redacted JSON for every page; collection identity/type; same-origin nonrepeating next-link chain; bounded aggregate member count and links reconciled to `Members@odata.count`; unsupported/not-applicable result without collection PASS when permitted; no-mutation audit.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: DMTF Redfish Data Model Specification DSP0268 and Resource and Schema Guide DSP2046 HostInterface/EthernetInterfaceCollection definitions, plus the target platform requirement for mandatory presence or population.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: GET only. Do not clear logs, disable TLS validation, expose credentials or sensitive topology, issue PATCH/POST, follow actions, alter host/BMC networking or mislabel Manager/System interfaces as HostEthernetInterfaces.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: None beyond normal authorized read-only access. An engineer supplies and judges any product-specific required member population.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent can discover links, retrieve and structurally validate the collection. It cannot infer which NICs must exist without the platform specification or claim individual member health without member GETs.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No target recovery is expected. On identity, TLS, HTTP or schema failure, retain redacted evidence and stop; correct the access/link/parser input before one bounded retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong BMC/Manager/HostInterface; missing signed presence/unsupported policy or pagination bounds; untrusted TLS; credential exposure; missing advertised link when support is required; non-success status; invalid JSON; cross-origin/repeated next link; page/member bound exceeded; collection identity/aggregate-count/link inconsistency; or any request to mutate or expand scope.

identified_defects: The source's human-readable/no-error criterion does not validate collection semantics.
V2 implies member link/status/speed and address/VLAN evidence despite the source's collection-only GET.
The source uses hardcoded credentials, TLS bypass and unrelated log clearing.
No platform-required collection population is supplied.
reason_for_change: Keep the correct read-only classification while enforcing the exact HostInterface collection boundary and preventing collection membership from being overclaimed as individual NIC telemetry or health.

new_technical_evidence.title: Redfish Resource and Schema Guide
new_technical_evidence.supports: `HostEthernetInterfaces` is a read-only link from a HostInterface to an EthernetInterface collection for NICs the computer system uses to communicate with that host interface, and the standard example uses the workbook URI shape.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The target firmware's schema version and required collection population remain platform-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: Redfish Data Model Specification
new_technical_evidence.supports: The Manager HostInterface HostEthernetInterfaces path is a standard EthernetInterfaceCollection URI distinct from Manager and System EthernetInterfaces collections.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Member details require separate resource retrieval and are not guaranteed inline in the collection.

removed_ambiguities: Distinguishes host-interface NICs from BMC management and System NIC collections.
Defines collection-only evidence and excludes member dereference.
Separates structural success from product-specific required population.
resolved_blockers: No blocker exists for the standard read-only collection GET.
remaining_blockers: A product-specific required member count or identity cannot be judged without the platform requirement; collection retrieval remains ready.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains secure automated retrieval but removes unsupported per-member telemetry claims and provides precise collection identity/count/link acceptance without expanding the original one-GET test.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Initial validation found truncated-pagination and unsupported-state risks. After revision, isolated revalidation confirmed bounded same-origin nonrepeating pagination, preservation of every page, aggregate count reconciliation, no member dereference, signed absent/unsupported disposition, trusted TLS/authentication, strict GET-only scope, and no partial or unsupported collection PASS.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 1359 performs one GET on the HostInterface-linked HostEthernetInterfaces collection.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly secures the GET but overreaches into individual member telemetry not supplied by the collection-only source step.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow link discovery and one trusted collection GET; prohibit writes, log clearing, scope confusion and unstated member dereference.
